The actual first-person childhood mishearing is printed at https://eichie.jp/advisements/9568: a Julie song's 聞き分けのない女の頬を was remembered as 父は毛のない女の頬を. The parenthetical ジュリーの歌 only names the source, while キキワケ and チチワケ contrast; in 父は毛, は is pronounced wa. 末尾「（ジュリーの歌）」は発話ではなく出典注記として正規化し、SrcOriginalを保持する。
decisions.Reason: Keep the phrase fragment 聞き分け/父は毛. The parenthetical names the source and is not speech; the actual source audio is unverified. The contextual readings are キキワケ/チチワケ, with は pronounced wa.
